  <h1>Adnan Ghribi</h1>
  <p class="role">Accelerator physicist at GANIL (CNRS), visiting scientist at CERN</p>
  <p class="bio">I build machine-learning tools for particle accelerators and study collective effects in the FCC-ee high energy booster.
  Fault diagnosis on superconducting RF, surrogate models, Bayesian optimisation, open-source LLM tooling.
  Earlier: cryogenics for the SPIRAL2 linac, and instrumentation for CMB polarisation experiments.</p>
